epochs.effective_basis: The 2023 rules took effect with the first registration-based main-board listing; the first such SSE listings began trading on 2023-04-10.
The exchange states that the revised rules take effect on 2026-07-06.

uncovered_intervals.reason: The prior SSE main-board rule version and transition mapping for this interval have not yet been added to this registry.

application_limits: This registry records rule text and effective dates; it does not prove that a historical security-status field was available to a strategy at the time.
Daily limit prices still require the correct exchange reference price, corporate-action treatment, and effective security status for the date.
This scope is only SSE main-board ordinary A-shares; it is not a cross-board or cross-exchange rule table.
The 2026 risk-warning band transition applies from the stated effective date; status eligibility remains a separate point-in-time data gate.
